<div class="domain-banner domain-demographics">
<div class="domain-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-user-icon lucide-user"><path d="M19 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H9a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg></div>
<div class="domain-banner-text">
<div class="domain-heading">Demographics</div>
<p class="domain-description">Demographics contains subject identity, enrollment, study participation, longitudinal episode structure, survival status, family and medical history, and other contextual information needed to interpret records across the model.</p>
</div>

<section id="class-geneticanalysis" class="class-section" data-subsets="base all aml cns ews fa gct ls nbl nrsts pre rb rms" markdown="1">

<p class="class-description">GeneticAnalysis captures germline and somatic genomic findings, testing context, specimens, methods, genes, variants, copy number, cytogenetic findings, HGVS expressions, significance, inheritance, and related genomic interpretation fields.</p>

<section id="class-staging" class="class-section" data-subsets="base cns ews fa fprh gct hl ls lt nbl npc os pre rb rms" markdown="1">

<p class="class-description">Staging captures stage, group, TNM, disease extent, and staging-system details used to summarize disease burden and classification at a defined time point.</p>

<section id="class-stemcelltransplant" class="class-section" data-subsets="base all aml ews fa fprh gct hl rb" markdown="1">

<p class="class-description">StemCellTransplant records hematopoietic stem cell transplant details, including timing, transplant type, donor relationship, HLA matching, conditioning, cell source, CD34 collection or infusion, chimerism, and recovery status.</p>

<div class="domain-banner-text">
<div class="domain-heading">Monitoring</div>
<p class="domain-description">Monitoring contains response, residual disease, toxicity, late effects, subsequent neoplasms, reproductive outcomes, patient-reported outcomes, and other follow-up concepts used to evaluate disease course and treatment impact over time.</p>
</div>
</div>
